{
  "technical_and_design_decisions": [
    "Implement the increment within the existing Spring Cloud Data Flow, module, deployer, and CI conventions rather than introducing a new architecture.",
    "Expose runtime information through the existing shell command framework, with a structured response containing host, port, state, and other available module metadata.",
    "Implement YARN deployment through the existing Data Flow platform/deployer abstraction and Hadoop/YARN client APIs, preserving the same stream and task deployment model used by other platforms.",
    "Port the XD source module into the current repository using the current module naming, packaging, configuration, metadata, and build conventions.",
    "Refactor the build so SPI deployers are independently bundleable while retaining a compatible aggregate build for existing consumers.",
    "Replace XDRuntimeException usages with appropriate existing or newly defined Spring/Data Flow exception types, preserving useful error context and causal chains.",
    "Upgrade the GemFire sink to the latest release compatible with the selected Java and Spring dependency baselines, and update related configuration and compatibility tests.",
    "Add SFTP as an out-of-the-box source module, including module metadata, packaging, repository publication, documentation, and module-list registration.",
    "Implement CI changes as automated build, unit-test, integration-test, packaging, and compatibility checks for Data Flow and related modules, using existing CI infrastructure where possible.",
    "Use automated unit and integration tests as the primary verification mechanism, with focused manual smoke testing for shell behavior, YARN deployment, module discovery, and published artifacts."
  ],
  "assumptions": [
    "The increment is implemented by one developer who performs analysis, coding, testing, documentation, packaging, and CI work.",
    "The existing repositories, build system, CI infrastructure, deployment abstractions, and test environments are available and can be modified without organizational or access delays.",
    "The specification does not require new functionality in the Hadoop or YARN platform itself; the work is limited to integrating Data Flow with an existing YARN cluster.",
    "A representative Hadoop/YARN test environment or suitable integration-test harness is available for validating deployment behavior.",
    "The XD source module to be ported has an identifiable implementation and compatible licensing, and the port does not require a complete redesign of its external behavior.",
    "The latest GemFire sink release has a compatible API and dependency set; extensive application-level migration beyond the sink module is not required.",
    "SFTP support can use an established Java SFTP client library and does not require implementing a new SFTP protocol stack.",
    "CI pipeline changes can reuse existing build agents, credentials, artifact repositories, and deployment test infrastructure.",
    "Documentation means module metadata, configuration reference, usage examples, and relevant release notes; it does not include a complete rewrite of project documentation.",
    "Estimates include normal code review preparation and local verification but exclude waiting time for external reviews, infrastructure provisioning, release approvals, or unresolved upstream defects."
  ],
  "activities": [
    {
      "activity_id": "A1",
      "activity_name": "Increment analysis and technical design",
      "activity_description": "Inspect the existing Data Flow, XD, module, deployer, exception, build, and CI structures; map each user story to affected components; define interfaces, compatibility constraints, test strategy, and implementation sequencing.",
      "most_likely_effort": 3
    },
    {
      "activity_id": "A2",
      "activity_name": "Runtime information shell command",
      "activity_description": "Implement or extend the shell command that retrieves and displays runtime/module information, including host, port, status, and available deployment details; add command parsing, output formatting, error handling, unit tests, and shell-level tests.",
      "most_likely_effort": 5
    },
    {
      "activity_id": "A3",
      "activity_name": "YARN deployment support",
      "activity_description": "Implement the YARN deployment integration, including deployer configuration, application submission and lifecycle handling, resource and environment propagation, status and failure reporting, stream/task integration, unit tests, and representative YARN integration or smoke tests.",
      "most_likely_effort": 20
    },
    {
      "activity_id": "A4",
      "activity_name": "Port XD file source module",
      "activity_description": "Move the specified source module from XD into the current repository, adapt package names and APIs, align configuration and module metadata with current conventions, update build and publication descriptors, and add unit and integration coverage.",
      "most_likely_effort": 8
    },
    {
      "activity_id": "A5",
      "activity_name": "Independent SPI deployer bundling",
      "activity_description": "Break the build lifecycle into independently buildable and bundleable SPI deployer artifacts, update module and dependency boundaries, preserve aggregate build behavior where required, and verify generated artifacts and downstream consumption.",
      "most_likely_effort": 10
    },
    {
      "activity_id": "A6",
      "activity_name": "Remove XDRuntimeException",
      "activity_description": "Locate and classify XDRuntimeException usages, replace them with appropriate current exception types, preserve messages and causes, update tests and exception assertions, and remove obsolete XD exception dependencies.",
      "most_likely_effort": 4
    },
    {
      "activity_id": "A7",
      "activity_name": "Upgrade GemFire sink",
      "activity_description": "Upgrade the GemFire sink dependency and related configuration, resolve API or transitive dependency changes, validate startup and message delivery behavior, and update compatibility tests and documentation.",
      "most_likely_effort": 4
    },
    {
      "activity_id": "A8",
      "activity_name": "SFTP source module delivery",
      "activity_description": "Implement or port the SFTP source module, integrate its SFTP client and configuration, add module metadata and out-of-the-box registration, publish the module artifact to the Maven repository, and add functional tests and usage documentation.",
      "most_likely_effort": 10
    },
    {
      "activity_id": "A9",
      "activity_name": "CI pipeline gap resolution",
      "activity_description": "Identify missing CI coverage for Data Flow and related projects; add or repair build, unit-test, integration-test, packaging, artifact, and compatibility jobs; configure required parameters and reports; and verify execution on representative commits.",
      "most_likely_effort": 15
    },
    {
      "activity_id": "A10",
      "activity_name": "Cross-feature integration and regression testing",
      "activity_description": "Run the complete build and test matrix, validate module discovery and artifact publication, exercise shell and deployment workflows, investigate and fix regressions or integration defects, and perform final compatibility checks.",
      "most_likely_effort": 8
    },
    {
      "activity_id": "A11",
      "activity_name": "Documentation, release preparation, and final cleanup",
      "activity_description": "Update user and developer documentation, examples, module lists, release notes, build instructions, and migration notes; clean obsolete configuration; and prepare the increment for review and release.",
      "most_likely_effort": 4
    }
  ],
  "reported_total": {
    "most_likely_effort": 91
  }
}

technical_and_design_decisions: Implement the increment within the existing Spring Cloud Data Flow, module, deployer, and CI conventions rather than introducing a new architecture.
Expose runtime information through the existing shell command framework, with a structured response containing host, port, state, and other available module metadata.
Implement YARN deployment through the existing Data Flow platform/deployer abstraction and Hadoop/YARN client APIs, preserving the same stream and task deployment model used by other platforms.
Port the XD source module into the current repository using the current module naming, packaging, configuration, metadata, and build conventions.
Refactor the build so SPI deployers are independently bundleable while retaining a compatible aggregate build for existing consumers.
Replace XDRuntimeException usages with appropriate existing or newly defined Spring/Data Flow exception types, preserving useful error context and causal chains.
Upgrade the GemFire sink to the latest release compatible with the selected Java and Spring dependency baselines, and update related configuration and compatibility tests.
Add SFTP as an out-of-the-box source module, including module metadata, packaging, repository publication, documentation, and module-list registration.
Implement CI changes as automated build, unit-test, integration-test, packaging, and compatibility checks for Data Flow and related modules, using existing CI infrastructure where possible.
Use automated unit and integration tests as the primary verification mechanism, with focused manual smoke testing for shell behavior, YARN deployment, module discovery, and published artifacts.
assumptions: The increment is implemented by one developer who performs analysis, coding, testing, documentation, packaging, and CI work.
The existing repositories, build system, CI infrastructure, deployment abstractions, and test environments are available and can be modified without organizational or access delays.
The specification does not require new functionality in the Hadoop or YARN platform itself; the work is limited to integrating Data Flow with an existing YARN cluster.
A representative Hadoop/YARN test environment or suitable integration-test harness is available for validating deployment behavior.
The XD source module to be ported has an identifiable implementation and compatible licensing, and the port does not require a complete redesign of its external behavior.
The latest GemFire sink release has a compatible API and dependency set; extensive application-level migration beyond the sink module is not required.
SFTP support can use an established Java SFTP client library and does not require implementing a new SFTP protocol stack.
CI pipeline changes can reuse existing build agents, credentials, artifact repositories, and deployment test infrastructure.
Documentation means module metadata, configuration reference, usage examples, and relevant release notes; it does not include a complete rewrite of project documentation.
Estimates include normal code review preparation and local verification but exclude waiting time for external reviews, infrastructure provisioning, release approvals, or unresolved upstream defects.

activities.activity_description: Inspect the existing Data Flow, XD, module, deployer, exception, build, and CI structures; map each user story to affected components; define interfaces, compatibility constraints, test strategy, and implementation sequencing.

Implement or extend the shell command that retrieves and displays runtime/module information, including host, port, status, and available deployment details; add command parsing, output formatting, error handling, unit tests, and shell-level tests.

Implement the YARN deployment integration, including deployer configuration, application submission and lifecycle handling, resource and environment propagation, status and failure reporting, stream/task integration, unit tests, and representative YARN integration or smoke tests.

Move the specified source module from XD into the current repository, adapt package names and APIs, align configuration and module metadata with current conventions, update build and publication descriptors, and add unit and integration coverage.

Break the build lifecycle into independently buildable and bundleable SPI deployer artifacts, update module and dependency boundaries, preserve aggregate build behavior where required, and verify generated artifacts and downstream consumption.

Locate and classify XDRuntimeException usages, replace them with appropriate current exception types, preserve messages and causes, update tests and exception assertions, and remove obsolete XD exception dependencies.

Upgrade the GemFire sink dependency and related configuration, resolve API or transitive dependency changes, validate startup and message delivery behavior, and update compatibility tests and documentation.

Implement or port the SFTP source module, integrate its SFTP client and configuration, add module metadata and out-of-the-box registration, publish the module artifact to the Maven repository, and add functional tests and usage documentation.

Identify missing CI coverage for Data Flow and related projects; add or repair build, unit-test, integration-test, packaging, artifact, and compatibility jobs; configure required parameters and reports; and verify execution on representative commits.

Run the complete build and test matrix, validate module discovery and artifact publication, exercise shell and deployment workflows, investigate and fix regressions or integration defects, and perform final compatibility checks.

activities.activity_name: Documentation, release preparation, and final cleanup
activities.activity_description: Update user and developer documentation, examples, module lists, release notes, build instructions, and migration notes; clean obsolete configuration; and prepare the increment for review and release.
